canDoYue: 你識講換手錶電池、打開之後仍然防水、改皮錶帶、拆兩節、保養包、四點取。
canDoEn: Ask for a watch battery, check that it stays water resistant, switch to a leather strap, remove two links, and collect it at four o'clock under the warranty.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: My old watch has stopped working. Can you replace the dead battery later this afternoon?
dialogue.glossYue: 我隻舊手錶停咗。下晝可唔可以換粒電池？
dialogue.say: My old watch has stopped working. Can you replace the dead battery later this afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. A new battery takes about ten minutes, and the shop warranty covers it.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。換新電池大約十分鐘，舖頭保養包咗。
dialogue.say: Yes. A new battery takes about ten minutes, and the shop warranty covers it.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Good. Is this watch still water resistant after you open the sealed back case?
dialogue.glossYue: 好。打開密封底蓋之後，隻錶仲防唔防水？
dialogue.say: Good. Is this watch still water resistant after you open the sealed back case?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes, it stays water resistant. Would you like a leather strap on it instead?
dialogue.glossYue: 會，仍然防水。你想唔想改一條皮錶帶？
dialogue.say: Yes, it stays water resistant. Would you like a leather strap on it instead?

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: The leather strap looks nice. Can you remove two metal links from the band?
dialogue.glossYue: 皮錶帶幾靚。可唔可以喺錶帶拆兩節金屬扣？
dialogue.say: The leather strap looks nice. Can you remove two metal links from the band?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes, I can remove those two links. Your pick-up time is four o'clock.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以拆嗰兩節。你四點可以嚟取。
dialogue.say: Yes, I can remove those two links. Your pick-up time is four o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Four o'clock is perfect for me. Does the warranty cover the leather strap too?
dialogue.glossYue: 四點得。保養包唔包呢條皮錶帶？
dialogue.say: Four o'clock is perfect for me. Does the warranty cover the leather strap too?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes, the shop warranty covers that strap. Please collect the fixed watch at four o'clock.
dialogue.glossYue: 包。舖頭保養包呢條錶帶。請四點嚟取修好嘅手錶。
dialogue.say: Yes, the shop warranty covers that strap. Please collect the fixed watch at four o'clock.
